alerts.name: PULBASE staging - service unavailable
alerts.query: SELECT argMax(double1, timestamp) AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE

alerts.name: PULBASE staging - service recovered
alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND double6 > 0 AND double4 = double6 AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE

alerts.name: PULBASE staging - service monitor missing
alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE
